whyReopen: PR 201 was authored by @jaytipargal, who is also the only code owner (CODEOWNERS: /project, /.github, /Backend); GitHub forbids a PR author from approving their own PR, and ruleset 25339138 requires a code-owner approval plus last-push approval. Re-opening the same branch as eka-auto (recorded push/PR identity) makes the code owner a non-author.
sequence: close PR 201 with a comment pointing at the re-opened PR
switch gh identity to eka-auto; verify identity and repository permissions against targets.json
commit the ACCESS.md scope notes on the branch as eka-auto (also makes eka-auto the last pusher, satisfying require_last_push_approval)
open the replacement PR as eka-auto
wait for all eight required status checks; a check that could not run is Error, never Pass
approve as @jaytipargal (owner-directed self-review, rule 7, Internal tier D-1)
verify the Vercel production deployment of project jpbir against targets.json and record the receipt
rollback: Close the replacement PR and reopen #201; production is untouched until the merge, and revert covers after it.
